_note: Status data for /roadmap/ and the roadmap strip on the home page. Each product sits in a horizon (now, next or later) and a stage. To move a product along, change its "stage" (planning, designing, building, testing or live) or its "horizon", update "updated", and rebuild (python3 tools/build.py). Copy and the Trust figure live in src/roadmap.html.

stages.name: Planning
stages.means: Deciding what it is for, who it serves and what the first version must do.

stages.name: Designing
stages.means: Working out how it looks and behaves, and checking the idea with the people it is for.

stages.name: Building
stages.means: Writing the software for the first version.

stages.name: Testing
stages.means: A first version is with a small group of early users.

products.name: Trust
products.line: Proof, provenance and protection for every AI action in a company.

products.name: Notebook

products.name: An open shared memory
